name: Dollscapes
source:
New Dollscapes project featuring creatures from fantasy and cyberpunk worlds. The development process will focus on creating a lifelike experience, where characters feel alive, express emotions, remember all player actions, and react to the smallest events.

VR is NOT required to play this game.

Download link: https://www.patreon.com/dollscapes/about
translation:
New Dollscapes project featuring creatures from fantasy and cyberpunk worlds. The development process will focus on creating a lifelike experience, where characters feel alive, express emotions, remember all player actions, and react to the smallest events.

VR is NOT required to play this game.

Download link: https://www.patreon.com/dollscapes/about
